review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review; not independent approval)
review.decision: implement bounded independent editors, session search and truthful refusal feedback
review.notes: Requested by the user with the screenshot. Source inspection confirms singleton reentry and agent-label/title mismatch. Six old send receipts record refused-waiting but omit evidence; their exact original cause remains unknown. Native frontend/target failures also use this state, so the old UI can falsely imply a human decision. Preserve all existing identity, draft, approval, idempotency, unknown-result and redaction guards. No actual screen capture, TCC, pane input, service change or old session restore is part of synthetic verification. The user confirmed the earlier system-update build pause ended after reboot and disk recovery. Resume normal verification. No test source is edited before this sealed design is committed. Test implementation and results remain pending.

cases.description: Independent screenshot documents preserve drafts and callback ownership
cases.setup: Two synthetic images and two independent windows; first window sending or minimized
cases.action: Capture/open a second image; finish, fail, export or close either window in both orders
cases.expected: Every document retains its own image, marks, note, target, undo and receipt; a late result never closes/deletes/changes the other document; bounded document capacity refuses a new document without discarding existing ones; simultaneous sends from captures sharing a parent directory use different rendered files, retain their own pixel content, and closing one cannot remove the other attachment

cases.description: Session picker uses menu-bar identity and searchable keyboard navigation
cases.setup: Duplicate/long/Chinese titles, tmux session and pane IDs; working/waiting/gone targets; text input with marked composition
cases.action: Search exact/prefix/token/subsequence queries, move selection, submit or dismiss, refresh candidates
cases.expected: Primary title equals Agent.primary, location disambiguates identical titles; deterministic bounded fuzzy matching; arrows/Return/Escape work without sending the screenshot or changing annotation tools; IME Return commits composition only; no matches cannot pick a hidden row

cases.description: Screenshot refusal feedback distinguishes approval from connection and identity failures
cases.setup: Production receipt interpreter and real send refusal classification; synthetic known approval, stale/gone frontend, changed target, missing metadata and unknown outcomes
cases.action: Interpret receipts and inspect visible/accessible text, editable state and content-free diagnostics in both languages
cases.expected: Only explicit approval/menu evidence says waiting for a decision; known pre-mutation refusal states not sent, unknown receipt remains uncertain; no retry/fallback or approval answer; drafts survive; logs include stable reason and stage without screenshot path or message body; preserve the existing active-turn/next-turn/immediate receipt assertions and contradictory-exit protections when updating their explicit pre-mutation refusal expectation. Existing screenshot test assertions outside the changed copy remain unchanged.

cases.description: Repeated capture and CLI handoff use independent editor ownership
cases.setup: Injected selector and private image files, no actual screen recording or TCC
cases.action: Start a new capture while an editor exists; cancel/fail/capture twice; hand off CLI edit
cases.expected: Existing draft never causes capture shortcut to merely focus it; selection remains serialized, editor documents are independent; CLI handoff cannot replace a draft; permission denial and exhausted capacity preserve all open work; CLI-opened editors resolve targets from their own supplied store without requiring an earlier human capture or global snapshot

cases.description: Native active flags preserve refusal while distinguishing unknown state from known waiting
cases.setup: Production inputTurnPlan with synthetic metadata and bounded wire; known approval/input flags, future flags, empty/mixed lists
cases.action: Request image, direct user and coordination input under these states
cases.expected: Known waiting flags refuse before mutation with confirmation cause; unknown or mixed unknown flags also refuse before mutation but report unavailable state rather than asserting a human request. No queue/steer/start fallback is enabled, and existing clear-state behavior remains unchanged.
